purpose: Static guard that the prototype and production viewer lanes cannot disagree about a measurement.

checks.name: the production lane serves the same registry, byte for byte
the prototype lane imports the shared measurement engine
the production lane imports the shared measurement engine
the prototype lane drafts patterns through scripts/pattern_draft.mjs
pattern_draft.mjs sits on the shared flattening engine and DXF writer
the production lane carries no pattern drafting
checks.detail: read-only presentation: no flatten, no DXF

checks.name: the prototype lane does not reimplement the engine
the production lane does not reimplement the engine
measure_core.mjs names no asset-specific material
surface_path.mjs names no asset-specific material
the production lane hardcodes no material name
checks.detail: the measurement surface comes from the registry

checks.name: the production lane hardcodes no scan range
checks.detail: the scan comes from the registry

checks.name: the production lane refuses to measure without the registry
checks.detail: no silent default: without a registry it reports nothing

checks.name: the prototype names the material only inside its documented fallback
the prototype lane imports the shared pen tool
the production lane imports the shared pen tool
the prototype lane does not reimplement the pen
the production lane does not reimplement the pen
the prototype lane dispatches keys through the shared keymap
the prototype lane frames and turns the camera through the shared view geometry
checks.detail: imports scripts/view_geometry.mjs for framingDistance and turntable

checks.name: the production lane dispatches keys through the shared keymap
the production lane frames and turns the camera through the shared view geometry
checks.detail: imports scripts/view_geometry.mjs for framingDistance and turntable

checks.name: the prototype lane does not reimplement the keymap or view geometry
the production lane does not reimplement the keymap or view geometry
the pen records placement through the shared view geometry
checks.detail: imports scripts/view_geometry.mjs; placed_with is not computed twice

checks.name: the pen snaps through scripts/pen_snap.mjs and reimplements none of it
checks.detail: imports pen_snap.mjs; snap resolution is not computed twice

checks.name: the prototype lane does not reimplement snapping
checks.detail: snapping is reached only through the shared pen

checks.name: the production lane does not reimplement snapping
checks.detail: snapping is reached only through the shared pen

checks.name: the production host hardcodes no material name
checks.detail: the pen's surface roles come from the registry the measurement module loaded

checks.name: the pen binds no keys of its own
checks.detail: keys are the hosts' through the keymap, so both lanes read the same map

checks.name: the pen uses the one path model
checks.detail: imports surface_path.mjs and reintroduces no second path model
